Render scenes from a script

Source: R/render_file.R
render_file.Rd

Sources file and renders the named scenes (all scenes when scenes is NULL), each with its own copy of the settings, as manim render does. The script's name is the module name of the output directories (<media_dir>/videos/<file name>/<quality>/).

Usage

render_file(file, scenes = NULL, ..., found = NULL)

Arguments

file

Path to an R script defining Scene subclasses.

scenes

Scene class names; NULL renders all.

...

Passed to render(), for example quality = "l". An output_file can only be given when one scene is rendered.

found

Named list of scene generators, as returned by find_scenes(); by default the scenes defined in file.

Value

Output paths, invisibly.

Examples

file <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
writeLines(c(
  "library(manimR)",
  "SquareToCircle <- manim_scene(function(self) {",
  "  self$play(Transform(Square(), Circle()))",
  "})"), file)
# The last frame as a PNG file in the session's temporary directory.
render_file(file, "SquareToCircle", quality = "l", format = "png", media_dir = tempdir())
#> Rendering SquareToCircle ...
#> INFO File ready at '/tmp/Rtmpc9gvtP/images/file24026c2cfeb6/SquareToCircle_manimR_v0.1.0.png'
#> INFO Rendered SquareToCircle
#> Played 1 animations
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# A video in the media folder (by default in the session's temporary
# directory); this needs ffmpeg.
render_file(file, "SquareToCircle", quality = "l", preview = TRUE)
} # }
